ambiguities.detail: packages/ai/src/index.ts re-exports curated symbols from '@ai-sdk/gateway' and '@ai-sdk/provider-utils' (workspace:* deps). Part of the 'ai' public API is implemented in other workspace packages — a tool that stops at the package boundary silently drops 'tool', 'jsonSchema', 'gateway' etc. from the surface. The analyzer follows the hop via dist->src fallback at I (build/modern dist absent).

The '.' export has NO 'require' condition (types/import/default only) + 'type': 'module'. A CJS require('ai') falls through to default -> ./dist/index.js (ESM) -> ERR_REQUIRE_ESM at runtime. Report 'ESM-only entry'; do not invent a CJS mapping.
'./internal' <- internal/index.ts and './test' <- test/index.ts live at the package root, outside src/. A tool assuming all entries under src/ misses them.
tsdown bundles: dist module boundaries != source module boundaries. Analyze src, not dist.

importCases.note: Extensionless directory import -> index.ts in bundler mode; 2-hop barrel (analyzer probe: R)
workspace:* dep; exports '.' -> dist/index.js absent -> dist->src fallback at I (analyzer probe confirms). Stopping at the package boundary would silently drop re-exported symbols.

note: Only facts manually verified in research/validation/repos/vercel-ai.md, re-verified against the cloned tree at the pinned SHA (758b092b39df784ed06abdf7af42fa31b74c853f). The workspace hop is the sharpest finding: encode it at I, never silently drop it.
